answer_1.quote: Generating text from structured data has a variety of applications in natural language processing.
models: Transformer sequence-to-sequence models with graph embeddings and cross-lingual embeddings
answer_1.outputs: Generated text in multiple languages from Abstract Meaning Representations (AMR) input.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with detokenized BLEU using sacrebleu.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation by asking native speakers to evaluate word order, morphology, semantic faithfulness (with respect to the reference) and paraphrasing (how much the generation differs from the reference) on a 3 point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assessed morphology, word order, semantic faithfulness, and paraphrasing on a 1-3 scale.
